card.name: Verbs and links before narrative outcomes
card.fires_on: Scattered general-web words where a story or claim is about to continue, such as 'became', 'again' after once, 'the key to', 'secrets to', and 'Revolution' in book titles. No single word class fits all of them.

modes.label: Linking verbs and particles
modes.description: A verb or small word in the middle of a clause, right before the result or object is stated.
modes.example: Since Labor Day first<< became>> a federal holiday in 189

modes.label: Words in book titles
modes.description: A title word such as Revolution or Rule that leads into the rest of the title.
modes.example: The Health<< Revolution>> Ross Horne writes: "Referring

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mixed and give no clear picture; the suppressed ones are reveal-type words.
card.plain: It fires on mixed in-between words in general web text, with no clear medical theme.
